skill.name: internal-comms
skill.description: Draft internal company communications in established formats, including 3P updates, newsletters, FAQ responses, status reports, leadership updates, project updates, and incident reports.
skill.summary: Create concise internal updates using provided company context and format guidelines.
skill.author: ZhanlinCui

content.value_statement: Teams need clear internal updates in consistent formats. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code draft newsletters, 3P updates, FAQs, and status reports.
actual_capabilities: Selects a matching guideline for 3P updates, newsletters, FAQ answers, or general communications.
Drafts concise 3P updates with Progress, Plans, and Problems sections.
Builds company newsletter outlines with sections for announcements, priorities, leadership updates, and social updates.
Formats FAQ responses as short questions and answers based on provided or accessible company context.
Asks for audience, purpose, tone, and format when the communication type is unclear.
limitations: Requires user-provided context or authorized source access to produce accurate company updates.
Does not verify facts without access to official documents, announcements, or messages.
Does not replace legal, HR, executive, or incident response review for sensitive communications.
May need adaptation for company-specific voice, approval workflows, and confidentiality rules.

use_cases.title: Prepare Weekly Team Updates
use_cases.description: Turn team notes into a short 3P update with clear progress, plans, and blockers.

use_cases.title: Publish Company Newsletters
use_cases.description: Summarize major announcements, leadership updates, milestones, and social highlights for employees.

use_cases.title: Answer Employee Questions
use_cases.description: Create concise FAQ entries from common employee questions and official source material.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a 3P Update
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request with clear team notes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a 3P update for the product team covering last week and next week. Use these notes: [paste notes].

prompt_templates.title: Create a Newsletter
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a company newsletter for this month using these announcements, links, and milestones. Group related items into clear sections: [paste context].

prompt_templates.title: Build an FAQ
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request using source material and uncertainty handling.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create employee FAQ answers from these documents and questions. Link to authoritative sources and mark any answer that needs executive confirmation: [paste material].

prompt_templates.title: Shape an Executive Update
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request with audience, tone, and review constraints.
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a leadership update for executives. Keep it concise, data-driven, and suitable for review. Audience: [audience]. Purpose: [purpose]. Facts: [facts].

output_examples.input: Draft a 3P update for the support team from these weekly notes.
output_examples.output: The skill produces a short update with Progress, Plans, and Problems sections, using concise sentences and relevant metrics.

output_examples.input: Create a company newsletter from this list of announcements and links.
output_examples.output: The skill groups updates into employee-friendly sections, highlights company-wide impact, and keeps each bullet short.

output_examples.input: Answer common employee questions about an upcoming launch.
output_examples.output: The skill writes clear question and answer pairs, cites official sources when provided, and flags uncertain items.

best_practices: Provide the audience, time period, source material, and required approval path.
Use official documents, announcements, and links for sensitive or company-wide topics.
Review drafts for confidentiality, accuracy, and tone before sharing broadly.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to invent company facts, metrics, decisions, or executive statements.
Do not include confidential source material unless the tool and workspace are approved for it.
Do not publish sensitive HR, legal, security, or incident content without the required reviewers.

faq.question: What formats does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports 3P updates, company newsletters, FAQ responses, status reports, leadership updates, project updates, incident reports, and general communications.

faq.question: Does it need access to Slack, email, or documents?
faq.answer: It works best with authorized source access or pasted context. Without source material, it can ask for the missing details.

faq.question: Can it write executive communications?
faq.answer: Yes, it can draft leadership updates when you provide the audience, purpose, facts, and review expectations.

faq.question: Can it verify company facts?
faq.answer: It can use provided source material, but final factual review should come from owners or official communications channels.

faq.question: Is this skill only for Claude?
faq.answer: No. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should I provide before drafting?
faq.answer: Provide the communication type, audience, dates, source notes, important links, tone, and any required reviewers.
